data.description: 【陈 · 磨剑】静谧的剑道练习室内，陈盘腿坐于地板中央，手持细软的白棉布极其专注地擦拭着泛着赤红锋芒的赤霄剑身。察觉到你的到来，她收剑入鞘抬起头——「剑就像意志，一日不磨便会生锈。博士，随时准备好迎击下一次风暴了吗？」
data.promptProse: Ch'en carefully wipes her sword blade with an oil cloth in the dojo, serene eyes fixed on the polished section. Loose white martial-arts jacket with teal accents, dark-teal wide-leg hakama trousers and cloth obi retain the training outfit. The medium close-up includes blade and cloth with sliding screens behind. Cool morning light through the screens glints along the steel and reveals the cloth's weave, leaving gentle hand shadows across the supporting surface.
data.title: 陈 · 磨剑
